title: Canonical adjunction unit comparison for module inverse image
statement: For every scheme morphism i and commutative ring sheaf A, there exists an adjunction between the specified pro-etale module inverse-image functor and its ring-unit pushforward such that the abelian adjunct of its unit is an isomorphism at every module.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3; transport of the module pullback adjunction through strict AsSmall models and compatibility with the abelian inverse-image unit.

proof.text: Construct the module Hom equivalence by precomposing target morphisms with AsSmall.down, applying the actual model-site pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, and precomposing its transpose with AsSmall.up. The strict inverse identities give inverse Hom maps. The model adjunction naturality proves naturality on both sides, giving a canonical adjunction to the specified ring-unit pushforward. Its unit evaluated on an original-site section is the model module unit evaluated at the up-transported section.

Model base change preserves finite limits. Apply the model ring-unit presentation and the unit-normalized underlying module comparison. This gives an isomorphism from the underlying model module pullback to model abelian inverse image, whose pushforward composed with the module unit is the model abelian unit.

Restrict the original abelian adjunction along the fully faithful strict AsSmall sheaf equivalences. Compare the model abelian pullback adjunction with this restricted adjunction by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. Apply the original-site sheaf equivalence to Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, and rewrite the restricted unit directly using Mathlib Adjunction.map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app. The commuting isomorphisms are identities. This gives the original abelian unit without declaring or reproving a separate specialized model-unit theorem.

Transport the composite of the normalized module comparison and the abelian uniqueness isomorphism back by AsSmall.up. On sections, compose the normalized model unit equation and the mapped adjunction uniqueness equation with the explicit module unit formula. This proves that the forgotten canonical module unit followed by pushforward of this isomorphism equals the original abelian unit. The abelian Hom equivalence therefore identifies the mate of the forgotten module unit with the inverse of the isomorphism. Hence the mate is invertible at every module, and the constructed adjunction is the required witness. The final cancellation uses Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, functoriality and the isomorphism inverse identities.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3. G3 explicitly transports the module Hom equivalence and proves its unit formula; the normalized model comparison and uniqueness of abelian left adjoints then identify the mate with an inverse isomorphism. Repair: remove the duplicate private modelAbelianAdjunction_unit declaration and directly reuse the general Mathlib restriction-unit theorem in the mapped uniqueness equation.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleModuleInverseImage_canonicalUnitComparison {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ (adj₀ : (proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A ⊣
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange i)
      (J := ProEt.topology X) (K := ProEt.topology Z)
      (S := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) (R := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app A).hom
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})⟩))),
      let S := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A
      let R := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)
      ∀ M, IsIso (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).obj M)
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A).obj M))).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).map (adj₀.unit.app M)))
